name: emaki
description: Motion stories: articles, story players and narrated videos from one set of JSON scenes, in every language.

scripts.build:all: for d in emaki emaki-svelte emaki-react emaki-vue emaki-posting emaki-cli; do (cd packages/$d && bun run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.check:types: for d in packages/*/; do if grep -q '"check":' "${d}package.json"; then echo "→ svelte-check ${d}"; (cd "$d" && bun run check) || exit 1; elif [ -f "${d}tsconfig.json" ]; then echo "→ tsc ${d}"; (cd "$d" && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json) || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.check: bun run build:all && bun run check:types && bun run test:ci
scripts.publish:all: for dir in ./packages/*/; do grep -q '"private": true' "${dir}package.json" 2>/dev/null || (cd "$dir" && bun publish); done
scripts.release: bun run clean && bun install && bun run publish:all
scripts.test:browser: cd examples/svelte && bun run build && node browser.mjs
